title.value: Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act
title.provenance: SECTION 1. This act shall be known, and may be cited, as the Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act.

status.provenance: AB-2515 Menstrual products: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

pfas_definition.provenance: c) “Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances” or “PFAS” means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 25258.3. A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

date.provenance: Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product...

products.provenance: b) “Menstrual product” means a product used to collect menstruation and vaginal discharge, including, but not limited to, tampons, pads, sponges, menstruation underwear, disks, and menstrual cups, whether disposable or reusable.
